first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person F
entities.identification: The man slightly left of center with short black hair, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and a loosened narrow red tie.

entities.name: Person I
entities.identification: The woman slightly right of center, wearing a blue collared top and a pink headscarf tied with a decorative knot on the head.

entities.name: queue of vehicles in traffic congestion
entities.identification: The collection composed of multiple light-colored, silver-gray, and dark-colored cars on both sides of and behind the people.

entities.name: clear blue sky
entities.identification: The large expanse of light blue sky behind the people and vehicles, occupying the upper portion of the effective image area.

entities.name: surrounding crowd
entities.identification: The collection of other background people visible between the vehicles and above the car roofs, not redundantly including Person F, Person I, Person K, or Person L.

entities.name: Person L
entities.identification: The man gradually revealed from the right edge, wearing a black baseball cap, with long dark hair beneath the cap, and a bright yellow top.

entities.name: Person K
entities.identification: The woman beside the car window on the left with voluminous dark curly hair, wearing a dark top, with part of an orange-red area visible in front of the chest later in the clip.
